verdict.rationale: Docusign Identify offers multiple signer verification methods—ID document checks with biometric challenge, SMS one-time-passcode, knowledge-based/phone auth ('5 identity verifications'), and even risk-based dynamic verification that adjusts required strength per document/recipient—directly matching the legal-ops need to require stronger verification on sensitive documents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Identify in production and detail on knowledge-based verification specifics beyond marketing copy.
